question.text: Which investment vehicle has emerged as a good option for investors to gain exposure to real estate with smaller capital commitments?

explanation.text: The Logic: REITs enable investors to take exposure to real estate with smaller outflow commitments compared to direct real estate investments which often involve large capital commitments. REITs pool money from multiple investors to invest in income-generating real estate. The Trap: Infrastructure bonds invest in infrastructure projects, not real estate per se. Cross-Exam Context: REITs are tested in X-A and also relevant to XII and VI as listed investment products.
